sudo -n sh -c "cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-worker <<'INIT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# chkconfig: 2345 85 15
# description: Chrooted inventory background worker

CHROOT=/srv/inventory-chroot
PIDFILE=/var/run/inventory-worker.pid
LOGFILE=/srv/inventory-chroot/var/lib/inventory/worker.log
UID_NUM=101
GID_NUM=102

is_running() {
    [ -s \"$PIDFILE\" ] || return 1
    pid=`cat \"$PIDFILE\" 2>/dev/null` || return 1
    kill -0 \"$pid\" 2>/dev/null
}

start() {
    if is_running; then
        echo \"inventory-worker already running\"
        return 0
    fi
    rm -f \"$PIDFILE\"
    /usr/bin/perl -MPOSIX -e '
        my ($root, $uid, $gid) = @ARGV;
        chroot($root) or die \"chroot: $!\n\";
        chdir(\"/\") or die \"chdir: $!\n\";
        $) = \"$gid\";
        $( = $gid;
        POSIX::setgid($gid) == 0 or die \"setgid: $!\n\";
        POSIX::setuid($uid) == 0 or die \"setuid: $!\n\";
        exec \"/bin/sh\", \"/usr/local/sbin/inventory-worker\";
        die \"exec: $!\n\";
    ' \"$CHROOT\" \"$UID_NUM\" \"$GID_NUM\" >>\"$LOGFILE\" 2>&1 &
    pid=$!
    echo \"$pid\" > \"$PIDFILE\"
    sleep 1
    if kill -0 \"$pid\" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo \"Started inventory-worker (pid $pid)\"
        return 0
    fi
    echo \"Failed to start inventory-worker\"
    rm -f \"$PIDFILE\"
    return 1
}

stop() {
    if ! is_running; then
        echo \"inventory-worker is not running\"
        rm -f \"$PIDFILE\"
        return 0
    fi
    pid=`cat \"$PIDFILE\"`
    kill \"$pid\"
    i=0
    while kill -0 \"$pid\" 2>/dev/null && [ \"$i\" -lt 15 ]; do
        sleep 1
        i=`expr \"$i\" + 1`
    done
    if kill -0 \"$pid\" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill -9 \"$pid\"
    fi
    rm -f \"$PIDFILE\"
    echo \"Stopped inventory-worker\"
}

status_cmd() {
    if is_running; then
        pid=`cat \"$PIDFILE\"`
        echo \"inventory-worker is running (pid $pid)\"
        return 0
    fi
    echo \"inventory-worker is stopped\"
    return 3
}

case \"$1\" in
    start) start ;;
    stop) stop ;;
    restart) stop; start ;;
    status) status_cmd ;;
    *) echo \"Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}\"; exit 2 ;;
esac
INIT_EOF
chown root:root /etc/init.d/inventory-worker
chmod 0755 /etc/init.d/inventory-worker
/sbin/chkconfig --add inventory-worker
/sbin/chkconfig inventory-worker on
/sbin/chkconfig --list inventory-worker"
